business: Aroundly, a nightlife app that sells monthly visibility subscriptions to venues
by_segment: Owner or manager of a venue with weekly DJ sets
Owner or marketing manager of a nightclub
Owner of a bar or pub with music nights a few times a month
why_not: My nights get filled by my PR guys and the WhatsApp lists, not by an app nobody has installed yet. A free month is nice, but I'm not signing a 3-month minimum with a startup that has zero users.
I've already paid for a promo platform that brought nobody, and Instagram does the job for free. An app that isn't even public yet has no users, so why would I pay for it?

I fill my nights with PR people, WhatsApp lists and my regulars, not apps. Fifty euro a month plus VAT for three months minimum is real money on my margins, and I don't know if anyone in my town will open an app that isn't even public yet.

A monthly fee with a 3-month minimum is too much for a bar like mine, and my friend already does the Instagram while the PR guys fill the lists. I'd try the free month maybe, but I wouldn't commit to paying.
I already put every flyer on Instagram and stories and it works well enough, and my friend does it for me. I don't need another place to post, and I'm not paying for an app nobody is using yet.

I already post my DJ nights on Instagram and I don't have time to manage another platform. An app nobody uses yet isn't going to fill my room, and students already find out about the nights through Instagram and word of mouth.

I clear 28 grand a year and every monthly fee gets cut unless it fills the room, and I've got no proof an app nobody uses yet will bring people in on a Friday. I'm not signing a 3-month minimum for something that isn't even public.

I already post every flyer on Instagram and stories, my friend handles it and the PR guys fill the lists, and it works well enough. An app nobody uses yet doesn't give me anything extra, and my competitors will be on it too.
why_yes: The first month is free with no card, so I'd try Stage and let them load my DJ nights. I'd only keep paying if the dashboard gives me real numbers, which boosts never do.
flip: Proof of real users in my area (thousands of downloads in Friuli/Veneto) and a pilot with no 3-month lock-in, or a couple of other clubs I know already on it.
